title: Cantor's diagonal theorem
description: A direct diagonal argument. Expand Diagonal.selfContradiction to open its final contradiction.

title: Induction as a finite proof generator
description: Specialize n, then normalize to compute the Nat recursor. P, base and step remain premises.

title: Zero plus n equals n
description: A tactic proof by induction. The step uses a separately expandable equality lemma.

title: Hilbert calculus soundness
description: An actual soundness theorem for the K/S implicational calculus, by induction on derivations.

title: Lawvere's fixed-point theorem (Types)
description: Mathlib's diagonal fixed-point argument; the helper used by Cantor's theorem.

title: Cantor's theorem (Mathlib)
description: The imported Mathlib proof, via Lawvere's fixed-point argument. Try lemma expansion depth 1.

title: First-order compactness (Mathlib)
description: The genuine ultraproduct proof: a theory has a model iff every finite subtheory has a model. Larger expansions expose its supporting lemmas.
